about: Oracle Sales History workload for tools/sample_db_bench.py. origin 'upstream-view': the view and the two materialized views sh_create.sql ships (profits, cal_month_sales_mv, fweek_pscat_sales_mv, at the pinned commit), adapted to BigQuery as 'adaptation' says; 'authored': written for this eval on the star schema (time, product, customer with its country, channel and promotion dimensions; sales and costs facts).

queries.name: profits
queries.adaptation: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW profits AS dropped; table aliases written with AS and the column alias total_cost in lower case; the comma join and its four-column join condition are as upstream writes them
queries.sql: SELECT s.channel_id, s.cust_id, s.prod_id, s.promo_id, s.time_id, c.unit_cost, c.unit_price, s.amount_sold, s.quantity_sold, c.unit_cost * s.quantity_sold AS total_cost FROM costs AS c, sales AS s WHERE c.prod_id = s.prod_id AND c.time_id = s.time_id AND c.channel_id = s.channel_id AND c.promo_id = s.promo_id

queries.name: cal_month_sales_mv
queries.adaptation: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW ... ENABLE QUERY REWRITE AS dropped; the sh. schema prefix dropped; table aliases written with AS
queries.sql: SELECT t.calendar_month_desc, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS dollars FROM sales AS s, times AS t WHERE s.time_id = t.time_id GROUP BY t.calendar_month_desc

queries.name: fweek_pscat_sales_mv
queries.adaptation: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW ... ENABLE QUERY REWRITE AS dropped; the sh. schema prefix dropped; table aliases written with AS
queries.sql: SELECT t.week_ending_day, p.prod_subcategory, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS dollars, s.channel_id, s.promo_id FROM sales AS s, times AS t, products AS p WHERE s.time_id = t.time_id AND s.prod_id = p.prod_id GROUP BY t.week_ending_day, p.prod_subcategory, s.channel_id, s.promo_id
SELECT t.calendar_month_desc, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS dollars, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM sales AS s JOIN times AS t ON s.time_id = t.time_id GROUP BY t.calendar_month_desc
SELECT p.prod_category, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS revenue FROM sales AS s JOIN products AS p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id GROUP BY p.prod_category HAVING SUM(s.amount_sold) > 1000000

SELECT k.country_region, k.country_subregion, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS revenue FROM sales AS s JOIN customers AS c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id JOIN countries AS k ON c.country_id = k.country_id GROUP BY k.country_region, k.country_subregion

SELECT ch.channel_class, ch.channel_desc, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(s.quantity_sold) AS units FROM sales AS s JOIN channels AS ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id GROUP BY ch.channel_class, ch.channel_desc
SELECT DISTINCT prod_id, prod_name FROM products
SELECT DISTINCT time_id, calendar_year FROM times WHERE calendar_year = 2021
SELECT DISTINCT prod_category, prod_subcategory FROM products
SELECT prod_id, prod_name FROM products WHERE prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM sales WHERE channel_id = 9)
SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_last_name FROM customers AS c WHERE c.country_id = 52790 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales AS s WHERE s.cust_id = c.cust_id AND s.time_id >= DATE '2022-01-01')
SELECT p.promo_id, p.promo_name FROM promotions AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales AS s WHERE s.promo_id = p.promo_id)
SELECT d.cust_id FROM supplementary_demographics AS d WHERE d.comments NOT IN (SELECT e.comments FROM supplementary_demographics AS e WHERE e.occupation = 'Farming' AND e.comments IS NOT NULL)
SELECT prod_id, prod_name FROM products WHERE prod_id NOT IN (SELECT prod_id FROM costs WHERE channel_id = 9)
SELECT prod_id, prod_name, prod_list_price FROM products WHERE prod_list_price > (SELECT AVG(prod_list_price) FROM products)
SELECT s.prod_id, s.cust_id, s.amount_sold FROM sales AS s WHERE s.time_id = DATE '2022-12-24' AND s.amount_sold > (SELECT AVG(s2.amount_sold) FROM sales AS s2 WHERE s2.prod_id = s.prod_id)
SELECT cust_id FROM sales WHERE channel_id = 9 AND time_id >= DATE '2022-01-01' UNION ALL SELECT cust_id FROM sales WHERE channel_id = 4 AND time_id >= DATE '2022-12-01'
SELECT cust_id FROM sales WHERE channel_id = 9 UNION DISTINCT SELECT cust_id FROM sales WHERE promo_id = 350 AND time_id >= DATE '2022-06-01'
SELECT cust_id FROM sales WHERE channel_id = 2 AND time_id >= DATE '2022-06-01' INTERSECT DISTINCT SELECT cust_id FROM sales WHERE channel_id = 3 AND time_id >= DATE '2022-06-01'
SELECT cust_id FROM customers EXCEPT DISTINCT SELECT cust_id FROM sales
SELECT prod_id, revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT prod_id, SUM(amount_sold) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY prod_id) AS r

SELECT calendar_month_desc, dollars, SUM(dollars) OVER (ORDER BY calendar_month_desc) AS running FROM (SELECT t.calendar_month_desc, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS dollars FROM sales AS s JOIN times AS t ON s.time_id = t.time_id GROUP BY t.calendar_month_desc) AS m

SELECT calendar_month_desc, dollars, dollars - LAG(dollars) OVER (ORDER BY calendar_month_desc) AS change FROM (SELECT t.calendar_month_desc, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS dollars FROM sales AS s JOIN times AS t ON s.time_id = t.time_id GROUP BY t.calendar_month_desc) AS m

WITH monthly AS (SELECT t.calendar_month_desc, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS dollars FROM sales AS s JOIN times AS t ON s.time_id = t.time_id GROUP BY t.calendar_month_desc), unused AS (SELECT cust_id FROM customers), big AS (SELECT * FROM monthly WHERE dollars > 1500000) SELECT calendar_month_desc, dollars FROM big
SELECT prod_id, revenue FROM (SELECT prod_id, SUM(amount_sold) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY prod_id) AS r WHERE TRUE
SELECT ((prod_id)), (prod_name) FROM products WHERE ((prod_category = 'Baseball') AND (prod_list_price > 20))
SELECT p.prod_category, AVG(c.unit_price - c.unit_cost) AS margin, COUNT(*) AS price_points FROM costs AS c JOIN products AS p ON c.prod_id = p.prod_id GROUP BY p.prod_category
SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_last_name FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN supplementary_demographics AS d ON c.cust_id = d.cust_id
SELECT s.prod_id, s.amount_sold FROM sales AS s JOIN products AS p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id WHERE s.time_id = DATE '2022-12-24'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS lines FROM sales AS s JOIN times AS t ON s.time_id = t.time_id WHERE t.calendar_year = 2021

SELECT t.calendar_month_desc, SUM(a.dollars) AS dollars FROM (SELECT time_id, SUM(amount_sold) AS dollars FROM sales GROUP BY time_id) AS a JOIN times AS t ON a.time_id = t.time_id GROUP BY t.calendar_month_desc
SELECT p.prod_id, p.prod_name, p.prod_category, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS revenue FROM sales AS s JOIN products AS p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id GROUP BY p.prod_id, p.prod_name, p.prod_category
SELECT channel_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS customers FROM sales GROUP BY channel_id
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM time_id) AS y, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM time_id) AS q, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM sales GROUP BY y, q
SELECT DATE_TRUNC(time_id, MONTH) AS month, SUM(quantity_sold) AS units FROM sales GROUP BY month
SELECT prod_id, SUM(CASE WHEN channel_id = 3 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS direct_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN channel_id <> 3 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS other_sales FROM sales GROUP BY prod_id
SELECT SUBSTR(cust_email, STRPOS(cust_email, '@') + 1) AS domain, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY domain

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_last_name, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS spend FROM customers AS c JOIN sales AS s ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_last_name ORDER BY spend DESC, c.cust_id LIMIT 10
SELECT pr.promo_category, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS dollars FROM sales AS s JOIN promotions AS pr ON s.promo_id = pr.promo_id GROUP BY pr.promo_category

SELECT s.prod_id, s.time_id, s.channel_id, s.promo_id FROM sales AS s LEFT JOIN costs AS c ON s.prod_id = c.prod_id AND s.time_id = c.time_id AND s.channel_id = c.channel_id AND s.promo_id = c.promo_id WHERE c.prod_id IS NULL
SELECT calendar_year, fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS days FROM times GROUP BY calendar_year, fiscal_year
SELECT education, occupation, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM supplementary_demographics GROUP BY ROLLUP (education, occupation)

SELECT p.channel_id, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(p.total_cost) AS cost FROM (SELECT s.channel_id, s.cust_id, s.prod_id, s.promo_id, s.time_id, c.unit_cost, c.unit_price, s.amount_sold, s.quantity_sold, c.unit_cost * s.quantity_sold AS total_cost FROM costs AS c, sales AS s WHERE c.prod_id = s.prod_id AND c.time_id = s.time_id AND c.channel_id = s.channel_id AND c.promo_id = s.promo_id) AS p GROUP BY p.channel_id
SELECT pr.prod_category, SUM(v.amount_sold - v.total_cost) AS profit FROM profits AS v JOIN products AS pr ON v.prod_id = pr.prod_id GROUP BY pr.prod_category
